description: A housing: a 2.8 mm plate (z 0..2.8) with walls to z 15, a centre column, a barrel cut 1.6 mm deep from the bottom, a lid recess and two tapered pockets. Extrude1 then cuts two circle profiles of `housing pellet exit` from the barrel cut's floor (the face at z 1.6) up to the plate's top face (z 2.8). It reports no error, but the hole stays closed: the top face at z 2.8 keeps its area over the hole, and a 28.28 mm2 face at z 2.8 faces down under it, a zero-thickness skin. The sketches are added as a design stores them: solved again, their points move by up to 1e-6 mm and the same cut opens the hole, so the stored positions are part of the case. Result: no face at z 2.8 faces down.
